items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Bennie Moten sent down right here...sent for him to come back to Kansas City, and he played with his band.

ctx.x: Boy, I guess you were lucky to get him.
Uh-huh. And he wasn't down there that long before Bennie Moten sent down right here...sent for him to come back to Kansas City, and he played with his band.
That would have been '31 or so.
